name: Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe (OSCE)
description: A white field bearing the organisation's logotype — the letters 'OSCE' in white on four blue squares — across the centre.
history: Introduced on 1 January 1995, when the Conference on Security and Co-operation in Europe, begun at Helsinki in 1975, was renamed the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe. Versions with the German and Russian acronyms also exist.

features.role: the letters 'OSCE' in white on blue squares
